content: Probe 2026-10-12: wago.tools api/builds and db2 CSV endpoints returned 503 maintenance page (were 200 on 2026-09-25 per todo). nether.wowhead.com/forever/tooltip/item/<id> returns 200 JSON {name, quality, icon, tooltip HTML, spells}; 404 {error: ID is out of range} for unknown ids. Tooltip HTML carries slot text, <!--scstartC:S--> item class/subclass, <!--statN--> stat ids (3 agi, 4 str, 5 int, 6 spi, 7 sta). WoWDBDefs: Item has ClassID, SubclassID, InventoryType; ItemSparse has Display_lang, InventoryType, ItemLevel, OverallQualityID, StatModifier_bonusStat, AllowableClass.
